raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 2026-01-15 ingestion change added the v2 collector, which emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver_transactions stores both without normalizing. The v2 rows are therefore shifted about 6 hours early, which pushes some transactions into the 00:00-06:00 window and moves them across business-date boundaries (the 31-row 2026-01-19 volume drop). Converting v2 timestamps from UTC to America/Chicago before deriving txn_date should restore consistent local-time semantics.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') x;"}}
